verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6 because its orderly registers and semantic failure routing show deliberate construction, but oversized lower containers, a broad empty bottom band, and long perimeter wires keep it from reading as a finished pin-up.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Fail: the main workflow occupies the upper and middle frame, while stretched lower sections and substantial unused space near the bottom make the composition feel underfilled.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Red dashed routes consistently communicate failure handling and gray carries the primary flows, though the isolated blue feedback arrow is not integrated into a broader semantic color system.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Fail: no junction crosshairs are visible, but several extremely long red dashed routes run around the board perimeter and read more like exposed routing infrastructure than polished flow composition.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The two four-panel workflow rows hold strong horizontal and vertical registers, but the oversized sparse lower panels and tiny labels create an uneven density rhythm.
